title: Peacock with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='12' ry='16' fill='#2E8B9E'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d='M50 54 Q48 44 50 38' stroke='#3CB4C8' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='8' fill='#3CB4C8'/>

  <line x1='50' y1='26' x2='46' y2='16' stroke='#FFD23F' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='46' cy='15' r='2' fill='#FF7B54'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='2' fill='#FF7B54'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='15' r='2' fill='#FF7B54'/>

  <polygon points='56,33 62,35 56,37' fill='#FF7B54'/>

  <g>
    <path d='M50 78 Q30 60 14 50' stroke='#5D3FD3' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
    <circle cx='14' cy='50' r='7' fill='#7B68EE'/>
    <circle cx='14' cy='50' r='4' fill='#FFD23F'/>
    <circle cx='14' cy='50' r='2' fill='#FF7B54'/>

    <path d='M50 80 Q28 68 18 60' stroke='#5D3FD3' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>

    <circle cx='18' cy='60' r='3.8' fill='#FFD23F'/>
    <circle cx='18' cy='60' r='1.8' fill='#FF7B54'/>

    <path d='M50 80 Q35 72 30 68' stroke='#5D3FD3' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none'/>

    <circle cx='86' cy='50' r='2' fill='#FF7B54'/>

    <path d='M50 80 Q72 68 82 60' stroke='#5D3FD3' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
    <circle cx='82' cy='60' r='6.5' fill='#7B68EE'/>
    <circle cx='82' cy='60' r='3.8' fill='#FFD23F'/>

    <circle cx='70' cy='68' r='3.2' fill='#FFD23F'/>

  <line x1='57' y1='90' x2='53' y2='92' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='57' y1='90' x2='57' y2='93' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='57' y1='90' x2='61' y2='92' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M41 68 Q46 76 52 78' stroke='#1F6B7A' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
